name: After § 77
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 77a. Urges the Commission to step up cooperation with the United States on its foreign policy combating drug cartels and transnational crime organisations with their origins in Latin America and the Caribbean, as they pose a direct threat to the national security of the EU Member States; urges the Commission to immediately suspend any financial aid for those regimes not complying with the most basic fundamental rights of their citizens, such as the regimes in Venezuela, Cuba and Nicaragua; calls, in particular, on the Commission to trigger the democratic clause and immediately suspend the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement between the EU and Cuba;
